create_arkitscenes_dataset: create an ARKitScenes dataset instance with train split and root path for stereo view loading
load_arkitscenes_metadata: load ARKitScenes dataset metadata including scenes, images, intrinsics, trajectories, and image pairs from npz file
get_stereo_views: get a pair of stereo views with RGB images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given index
review_arkitscenes_class: review the ARKitScenes class that extends BaseStereoViewDataset for loading preprocessed ARKitScenes data
run_arkitscenes_visualization: run the ARKitScenes dataset main block to visualize random stereo view pairs with point clouds and cameras
